Record Class TypefaceLayout.Cluster

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.client.typeface.TypefaceLayout.Cluster
Record Components:
start - first UTF-16 offset in the formatted source
end - offset following the last source code point
text - visible text spanned by this cluster
style - parsed formatting
face - outline face or null for a line separator
glyphs - outlines in draw order
advance - unhinted design advance
ink - unhinted outline bounds relative to the baseline
rtl - whether the cluster reads from right to left
Enclosing class:
TypefaceLayout
public static record TypefaceLayout.Cluster(int start, int end, String text, ChromaticText.Style style, net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.client.typeface.TypefaceFamily.Face face, List<net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.client.typeface.TypefaceLayout.Glyph> glyphs, float advance, Rectangle2D ink, boolean rtl) extends Record
A complete grapheme or ligature. All outlines in it receive one effect index.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
